The petitioner has approached this Court seeking a direction to second respondent to complete the investigation and file a final report in Crime No.46 of 2024 dated 24.02.2024, within a time frame.

3.The learned Government Advocate(Crl.side) appearing for the respondents submits that the case came to be registered only on 24.02.2024 and the investigation is under progress.
